text: 今日上午，A股调整幅度有所加大。何以出现“外围小跌、A股大跌”的背离？市场专业人士认为，更多来自情绪面的放大，而非估值或盈利的实质变化。在外围扰动加大的情况下，部分投资者信心仍待修复，容易在短期波动中产生恐慌情绪、跟风操作。有受访专家表示：“外部因素只是短期扰动，真正决定市场韧性的还是社会经济改革发展成效。总的来看A股基本面、政策面和资金面均稳健向好，外部扰动因素并不改变市场的内在韧性。”对于内在韧性来说，最核心的支撑是中国资产的安全溢价和强劲韧性。（上证报）
text_en: This morning, the A-share adjustment widened somewhat. Why did the divergence of "small declines overseas, sharp declines in A-shares" occur? Market professionals believe it comes more from an amplification of sentiment than from substantive changes in valuations or earnings. Amid increased external disturbances, some investors' confidence still needs to be restored, making them prone to panic and herd behavior during short-term volatility. One interviewed expert said: "External factors are only short-term disturbances; what truly determines market resilience is the effectiveness of socioeconomic reform and development. Overall, the fundamentals, policy environment and liquidity conditions of A-shares are stable and improving, and external disturbances will not change the market's inherent resilience." For this inherent resilience, the most core support is the safety premium and strong resilience of Chinese assets. (Shanghai Securities News)
